   OLD TOWN LA VERNE BUSINESS IMPROVEMENT DISTIRICT
  MINUTES OF THE REGULAR MEETING
  Monday, October 7, 2024

1.  WELCOME AND CALL TO ORDER

  Chairperson Walters called the meeting to order at 8:31 a.m. The following Board
  Members were present: Craig Walters, Marianne Stark, Micky Rehm, and George
  Henderson. Board Members absent: Zuhey Espinoza. City Representatives present:
  Community Development Director Eric Scherer, and Secretary Natalie Hiatt. Others
  present: Ken Valmonte and Fang Wang.

2.  CALENDAR
  Halloween Trick or Treat  Thursday, October 31st 2-5pm
  Cruisin La Verne Car Show  Saturday, November 23rd 10am-
  4pm
  Holiday Stroll  Saturday, December 7th 3pm

3.  APPROVAL OF THE MINUTES

  It was moved by Ms. Rehm and seconded by Mr. Henderson to approve the minutes of
  the September 9, 2024 meeting. Motion carried by a 4-0 vote.

4.  NEW BUSINESS

  A.  Holiday Stroll – Mr. Henderson stated that Sanders Towing is able to pick up and
  deliver the Christmas tree to Mainiero Square.

  Ms. Rehm stated that Dr. Espinoza is helping coordinate the ULV choir. Ms.
  Rehm is working on the Holiday Stroll postcard and so far, only one person has
  responded.

  Mr. Scherer stated that the Historical Society’s truck will be on display at the
  Holiday Stroll. The Historical Society expressed interest in being the non-profit
  partner for the next Wine Walk. Mr. Scherer will also check if the vintage fire
  truck is available.

  B.  BID Evaluation Consultant – Select date for a Special Meeting – A tentative
  Special Meeting date was scheduled for October 29th at City Hall.

  Chairperson Walters stated that he met with City Manager Ken Domer and the
  ULV Marketing Club. They discussed assisting with market research and strategy.

5.  CONTINUED BUSINESS

  None
 6.  COMMITTEE REPORTS/ UPDATES

  A. City Report (Eric Scherer): None
  B. University Report (Zuhey Espinoza): None
  C. Marketing (Micky Rehm): Ms. Rehm will continue posting events to the group’s
  social media accounts.
  D. Chamber Report: None
  E. Social Media Update (Micky Rehm): None
  F. Financial Report: None

7.  PUBLIC COMMENT (Any discussion or action on non-agendized items must be
  deferred to the following meeting, as required by California Brown Act Law)

  Ms. Rehm expressed concern with the homeless congregating in Old Town. Mr. Scherer
  referred her to Officer Jay Alvarado.

8.  ADJOURNMENT

  Meeting was adjourned at 8:57 a.m., the special meeting to be held on October 29, 2024
  at 8:30 a.m. at City Hall – 3660 D Street, La Verne CA 91750

  Respectively submitted,

  _____________________
  Natalie Hiatt
   OLD TOWN LA VERNE BUSINESS IMPROVEMENT DISTIRICT
  MINUTES OF THE SPECIAL MEETING
  Tuesday, October 29, 2024

1.  WELCOME AND CALL TO ORDER

  Chairperson Walters called the meeting to order at 8:35 a.m. The following Board
  Members were present: Craig Walters, Micky Rehm, Zuhey Espinoza, and George
  Henderson. Board Members absent: Marianne Stark. City Representatives present:
  Community Development Director Eric Scherer, City Manager Ken Domer, Mayor Tim
  Hepburn, Councilman Steve Johnson, and Secretary Natalie Hiatt. Others present:
  Nathan Ulsh, Carly Adams, Cindy Feng, Maria Faura and Luis Faura.

2.  CALENDAR
  Halloween Trick or Treat  Thursday, October 31st 2-5pm
  Cruisin La Verne Car Show  Saturday, November 23rd 10am-
  4pm
  Holiday Stroll  Saturday, December 7th 3pm

3.  APPROVAL OF THE MINUTES

  None

4.  NEW BUSINESS

  A.  Introduction of Community Strategies for Evaluation and Action Plan – Nathan
  Ulsh of Community Strong Strategies was present at the meeting and his
  colleagues Carly Adams and Cindy Feng joined via Zoom. The Board discussed
  their vision of Old Town and the areas in need of improvement.

  Mayor Hepburn stated the importance of Old Town becoming a destination with
  the redevelopment, retail, and Gold Line.

  Mr. Ulsh and his team will perform a four-month survey, build a strategy, and
  make recommendations. He stated that there are also grants available outside of
  the City that can be utilized.

  Mr. Ulsh will attend the BID’s next regular meeting in December.

5.  CONTINUED BUSINESS

  A.  Holiday Stroll Update – Ms. Rehm stated that she spoke to Community Services
  and they do not have staff available to work the event and are unable to provide
  Santa’s chair. The ULV choir is also not available to perform. Ms. Rehm
  recommended the parents take their own pictures.
   Mr. Domer said that the microphone and lights will be available. Ms. Faura
  offered to provide Santa’s chair.

  B.  Cancellation of November 4th Meeting – The next regular meeting was cancelled
  and the Board will meet again on December 2nd.

6.  COMMITTEE REPORTS/ UPDATES

  A. City Report (Eric Scherer): None
  B. University Report (Zuhey Espinoza): Dr. Espinoza stated that the University raised
  $100,000 at their golf tournament. She also announced the next Gala will be held
  May 3, 2025.
  C. Marketing (Micky Rehm): None
  D. Chamber Report: None
  E. Social Media Update (Micky Rehm): None
  F. Financial Report: None

7.  PUBLIC COMMENT (Any discussion or action on non-agendized items must be
  deferred to the following meeting, as required by California Brown Act Law)

  None

8.  ADJOURNMENT

  Meeting was adjourned at 8:57 a.m. to the regular meeting to be held on December 2,
  2024 at 8:30 a.m. the next regular meeting to be held on December 2, 2024 at 8:30 a.m. at
  Café Wang – 2316 D Street, La Verne CA 91750

  Respectively submitted,

  _____________________
  Natalie Hiatt

  3,
  2025.

  Mr. Scherer asked the restaurant owners present to stay after the meeting to have

 6.  COMMITTEE REPORTS/ UPDATES
